capacity_model.allocation_rule: Uncommitted capacity is not on-call; it is scheduled only after sponsor approval and expires at period close.
capacity_model.consumption_rule: Every meeting, review, analysis, message, postmortem, and approved change consumes the same finite capacity ledger.

decision_rights.internal_owner: Operates the system and owns daily decisions.
decision_rights.provider: Advises and executes only named accepted-backlog changes within included delivery days.
decision_rights.sponsor: Approves scope, access, capacity changes, renewal, and exit.

escalation: scope new implementation as a separate install or change order
pause material security, privacy, legal, or contractual exceptions for human review
exit when the internal owner no longer exists or the review need is no longer finite

escalation_routes.authority_expansion: Stop the proposed change until the sponsor approves a named scope and acceptance path.
escalation_routes.capacity_exhaustion: Trade off the accepted backlog, defer to the next period, or scope a separate change order or Governance Install.
escalation_routes.missing_owner: Pause service and exit unless a new internal owner is named and accepts the current records.
escalation_routes.security_privacy_legal_contract: Pause the exception for the registered human review path; no provider override exists.

exclusions: unlimited implementation, feature work, or repository coverage
staff augmentation or an open-ended feature-delivery queue
executive substitution or ownership of daily operations
unrecorded access expansion or informal side projects
capacity_model.exhaustion_route: At exhaustion, trade off the accepted backlog, move work to the next period, or scope a separate change order or Governance Install; no standby is implied.

exit_steps: return the latest records and runbook
record the next review date or stop decision
renewal_exit.exit_trigger: The internal owner disappears, the need is no longer finite, or the sponsor chooses exit.
renewal_exit.renewal_gate: Evidence and capacity review plus a dated written renew or narrow decision before the next period.

response_envelope.business_hours: sponsor-agreed named business hours recorded before the period
clock_pause_conditions: waiting on required access or evidence
response_envelope.target_boundary: Planning targets only; no emergency or round-the-clock SLA.
response_envelope.timezone: sponsor-agreed named timezone recorded before the period

offer.acceptance: Each period ends with a capacity ledger proving consumed hours did not exceed included hours, reviewed evidence, explicit changes, current owners, and a dated written renew, narrow, or exit decision.

authority.boundary: The internal owner operates the system; changes occur only through the agreed backlog, access boundary, and acceptance path.

offer.name: Bounded Delivery-Governance Retainer
offer.timeline: One fixed review period at a time, renewable only after evidence and capacity review.
